title: [Latest dev] No profile change if only the target area was changed
body:
If I change the target area in a Local Profile and save it, then trigger a profile change, the profile change is not performed and the previous targets remain active.
Workaround: Start a profile for a few minutes with a percentage change, then - when switching back - the changed Local Profile with the changed targets is active.
Version: Latest devs (already for a longer time)
Pump: Combo

comments.body:
Confirmed
There are some fixes done in the past, but they didn't help in that case.

You must always have a small change in your basal profile (0,01) then the profile switch works without to change to a different profile first. Same with Medtronic pump and I think it has nothing to do with the pumpdriver.
